name: antigravity-subagent
description: Delegate bounded tasks from Codex to persistent, recoverable Google Antigravity CLI workers through a skill or MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent, recoverable Antigravity workers for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Adds a guarded skill and local stdio MCP server for persistent, resumable Google Antigravity CLI workers with recovery, status, cancellation, and audit metadata.
defaultPrompt: Use Antigravity as a subagent to review this approach.
Delegate this bounded research task to Antigravity.
Ask Antigravity for a second opinion on this bug.
